channel.title: Quickwell: new guides and calculators
channel.description: New free calculators and practical guides from Quickwell: holiday gift budgets, carrier pay checks, bills and everyday money.

item.title: Carrier Pay Calculators: Short Pay and Detention
item.description: Free calculators for owner-operators: broker short pay, factoring deposits and detention pay. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

item.title: Broker Short Pay Calculator for Carriers
item.description: Compare what the rate confirmation says you are owed with what the broker paid. See the shortfall in dollars and percent for one load.

item.title: Detention Pay Calculator for Truck Drivers
item.description: Enter hours at the dock, free time and the hourly detention rate from your rate confirmation to see what is billable for the stop.

item.title: Factoring Deposit Calculator: Fee and Reserve
item.description: Enter the invoice, your factoring fee and reserve to see the deposit you should expect, then compare it with what landed in your account.

item.title: Holiday Gift Budget Calculators | Quickwell
item.description: Free holiday gift budget calculators: set a spending cap per person for family, kids, coworkers and Secret Santa. Runs in your browser.

item.title: Big Family Christmas Budget: Cap Each Gift
item.description: Buying for a large family? Set one total, count nieces, nephews and adults, and get a cap for each so the list stays affordable.

item.title: Christmas Gift Budget Per Person Calculator
item.description: Work out how much to spend on each person for Christmas from your total budget. Adjust the split between close family and everyone else.

item.title: Family Gift Budget Planner for Kids and Adults
item.description: Split a family gift budget between kids and adults. See a cap for each child and each adult before you start shopping.

item.title: Holiday Budget Calculator: Set a Cap Per Person
item.description: Enter one total and how many people you buy for. Get a spending cap per person, with money held back for shipping and wrap.

item.title: Last-Minute Gift Budget: What Is Left Per Person
item.description: Already started shopping? Enter the money you have left and the people still on your list to see what you can spend on each.

item.title: Secret Santa and Coworker Gift Budget Calculator
item.description: Budget for office gifts, Secret Santa and teachers. Enter your total and headcount to get a cap per coworker and per exchange gift.
